description: This file contains utility functions for the Superset project, including user authentication, datasource handling, permission checks, data deserialization, and dashboard filter management.

methods.name: redirect_to_login
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to the login page, preserving the target URL.

methods.name: sanitize_datasource_data
methods.description: Removes sensitive parameters from datasource data.

methods.name: bootstrap_user_data
methods.description: Prepares user data payload, including roles and permissions if requested.

methods.name: get_config_value
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from the Flask app config.

methods.name: get_permissions
methods.description: Retrieves user roles and permissions related to data and database access.

methods.name: get_viz
methods.description: Creates a visualization object based on form data and datasource info.

methods.name: loads_request_json
methods.description: Safely loads JSON data from a string, returning empty dict on failure.

methods.name: get_form_data
methods.description: Extracts and compiles form data from request context, URL, or database slice.

methods.name: add_sqllab_custom_filters
methods.description: Adds custom SQLLab filters from request data into form data.

methods.name: get_datasource_info
methods.description: Extracts datasource ID and type from form data, supporting legacy formats.

methods.name: apply_display_max_row_limit
methods.description: Limits the number of rows in SQL query results for display.

methods.name: get_dashboard_extra_filters
methods.description: Retrieves applicable default filters for a dashboard slice.

methods.name: build_extra_filters
methods.description: Constructs extra filters based on dashboard layout and filter scope.

methods.name: is_slice_in_container
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard slice is within a specific container in layout.

methods.name: check_resource_permissions
methods.description: Decorator factory for permission checks on resources.

methods.name: check_explore_cache_perms
methods.description: Checks user permissions for cached explore JSON data.

methods.name: check_datasource_perms
methods.description: Verifies user access to a datasource or visualization.

methods.name: _deserialize_results_payload
methods.description: Deserializes query results payload, supporting msgpack and JSON.

methods.name: get_cta_schema_name
methods.description: Determines schema name for CTAS operations based on config function.
